verdict.rationale: The only first-party programmatic surface in the evidence is the Codex SDK, which automates coding tasks including CI jobs (docs-91), alongside a scriptable Codex CLI (docs-92). There is no documented public API for driving ChatGPT Chat or Work in general, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path (probe-3). Missing for 10: a documented public API covering the core ChatGPT product beyond Codex, published API reference or OpenAPI spec, auth and endpoint documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
